result.headline: CPSC recall: AirClub convertible bassinets can leave a gap that poses a fall hazard to infants.
result.safety_note: CPSC announced a recall of AirClub convertible bassinets on March 26, 2026, covering about 110,400 units. The mechanism that attaches the bassinet to an adult bed can create an opening between the sleeper and the mattress, which CPSC says poses a deadly fall hazard to infants and violates the mandatory standard for bedside sleepers. The remedy is a repair, with AirClub providing a replacement attachment. News coverage lists model QX-831 on the label under the mattress pad, so check your model.
